journeys.consumer: ordinary C++ service or command-line application
journeys.topology: one process logger adapter; one repeated source call site; 4096 level and frequency checks; every 64th call formats and emits
journeys.ownership: the macro owns one hidden call-site counter; the application owns the synchronous adapter
journeys.reason: conditional and count-limited diagnostic output is common library and service behavior independent of inference

journeys.consumer: inference runtime whose worker threads synchronously enter one process logger adapter
journeys.topology: eight persistent producer roles emit one preformatted borrowed record to one registered adapter; setup and teardown stay outside the measured steady state
journeys.ownership: the application owns one process logger adapter; HYLE owns only immutable registry publication and callback quiescence
journeys.peer: the immutable pre-v4 HYLE registry on the identical source workload
journeys.reason: the mem_reclaim reuse changes dispatch publication mechanics, so the normal one-adapter multi-producer route needs a regression gate; four and sixteen adapters remain capacity diagnostics

journeys.consumer: llama.cpp-shaped model loader with a host state/telemetry callback
journeys.topology: three independently owned model stages each receive 256 progress callbacks at 50 ms; first, every 200 ms and final observations produce 65 records per stage and 195 records total
journeys.ownership: each text/mmproj/spec load_progress_data owns its throttle state; the host owns the synchronous state callback and any copying or fan-out after it
journeys.peer: llama.cpp server-context load_progress_callback manual t_last_load_progress_ms gate
journeys.record_projection: event model.load_progress carries the ordered stage list as repeated stage attributes, current stage and floating progress value; the host may attach one model-load correlation, source and wall timestamp
journeys.reason: this exact current consumer replaces the stale v3 synthetic 16-slot/3-second replay; repeated keys preserve the source stage array without adding an owning or schema-specific container value

negative_space.multi_sink: 2, 4 and 16 independent HYLE sinks are registry capacity/contention diagnostics, not the normal product topology
negative_space.async_fanout: queueing, copying, file rotation, network export and application logger fan-out live behind the one synchronous adapter
negative_space.timing: the replay starts at a nonzero process time, injects deterministic monotonic and wall time, and forces the final observation exactly as llama.cpp does; clock acquisition is measured by Time rather than hidden inside Obs
negative_space.peer_boundary: llama.cpp supplies the real progress fields and cadence but not an equivalent public typed event schema; it is not presented as a structured-logging SOTA implementation
